name: Darryl Of Ilsenova
source:
Magic Affinity: Fire, Wind, Light

Although he has been present on the High Council for only a short time, the second prince of Ilsenova is known for his undeniable benevolence and gentleness. For, despite the heavy responsibilities that come with tending to the matters of his own kingdom, you can often find Darryl in town taking care of the downtrodden. 

Nonetheless, as amiable as he is, Darryl also possesses high magical abilities, garnering the respect of his servants and peers alike.

[From Kickstarter]
